facts.claim: Median free-to-paid conversion across all products is 8%, while freemium models sit closer to 2% to 5%
facts.excerpt: The median free-to-paid conversion rate across all products is 8%. Freemium models sit closer to 2-5%.

facts.claim: Across 80+ SaaS products, freemium-to-paid averaged 3.7%, ranging from 2.6% in ed-tech to 5.8% in reg-tech
facts.excerpt: An average freemium-to-paid conversion rate of 3.7% for traditional freemium, with industry variation from 2.6% in EdTech to 5.8% in RegTech.

facts.claim: In a survey of 200 B2B software products, one in four freemium products converts under 2.5% of free users within six months, and another quarter reaches 10% to 15%
facts.excerpt: One-in-four freemium products convert less than 2.5% of free users within six months, while another quarter manages 10-15%.

facts.claim: The SaaS-only median activation rate is 30%, against a blended free-to-paid conversion of 8%
facts.excerpt: The SaaS-only median activation rate is 30%, and the blended free-to-paid conversion rate is 8%.

facts.claim: Median trial-to-paid conversion is 42.5% for 17-32 day trials and 25.5% for trials of 4 days or fewer
facts.excerpt: 17-32 day trials have a median of 42.5%, while trials of 4 days or fewer have a median of 25.5%

facts.claim: Price localisation wins 62.3% of experiments, the highest win rate of any test type
facts.excerpt: Localization tests win 62.3% of the time in experiments, the highest win rate of any test type
